input_usuario: Liste os 5 vencedores com maior valor homologado em 2024.
query_referencia: WITH lic AS (SELECT h.nom_vencedor, SUM(CAST(h.vlr_global AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM licitacao_homologLicitacao h WHERE h.ano_referencia = 2024 AND h.vlr_global > 0 GROUP BY h.seq_licitacao, h.nom_vencedor) SELECT nom_vencedor, total FROM lic ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
query_gerada: SELECT nom_vencedor, SUM(CAST(vlr_global AS DECIMAL)) AS total_homologado FROM licitacao_homologLicitacao WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 GROUP BY nom_vencedor ORDER BY total_homologado DESC LIMIT 5;
